definitions.explanation: The final train of the day on a particular route.

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた。
{終電|しゅうでん}は{何時|なんじ}ですか。
examples.english: What time is the last train?

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}まであと{30分|さんじゅっぷん}だ。
examples.english: There are 30 minutes until the last train.

notes:
{終電|しゅうでん} is composed of {終|しゅう} (end) + {電|でん} (train, from {電車|でんしゃ}).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {終電|しゅうでん}に{乗|の}る: to catch the last train
- {終電|しゅうでん}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: to make the last train
- {終電|しゅうでん}を{逃|のが}す: to miss the last train

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Last trains in Japan typically run around midnight
- Missing the last train is common after drinking parties ({飲|の}み{会|かい})
- Options include taxis, capsule hotels, or karaoke until morning
